free_tier.stated: KVM 512M at EUR 2.50 per month: 1 vCPU, 512 MB RAM, 15 GB SSD, 500 GB a month of bandwidth, with 29 locations selectable on the row from Los Angeles and Montreal through Amsterdam, Frankfurt and Manchester to Singapore, Hong Kong, Tokyo and Sydney. KVM 1G is EUR 4.50 with 1 GB RAM, 30 GB SSD and 1 TB; KVM 2G is EUR 9.95 with 2 GB RAM, 50 GB SSD and 2 TB. VAT is not included and is charged separately to European Union customers without a valid VAT ID.
